title: The episode title, as the video opens
subtitle: Part N of 3 - building @konopskidev/ui

beats.caption: One line, the chapter title
beats.narration: One idea, spoken. About 60 words is 25 seconds. Spell out what must not be misread - 'dot css', 'src slash styles' - and never read code aloud.

beats.caption: The claim of the beat
beats.narration: Scene types: figure (a generated diagram), cards (three claims), terminal (a real shell session), workbench (a file typed in the real VS Code), workbench-split (a change beside its effect), preview (a live page, such as Storybook).

beats.caption: The file, typed
beats.narration: The real workbench types the file; the pace is the beat duration divided by the character count, so there is nothing to tune. prefill: true starts from the file on disk and types only what follows.

lines: /* the literal file contents, one string per line */

beats.caption: The change, and its effect
beats.narration: themeAt is a fraction of the beat: 0.52 flips the pane to dark a little past halfway.

beats.caption: The command, honestly replayed
beats.narration: A log name refers to video/build/logs/<name>.json, written by sandbox.mjs from a real run; vhs.mjs films those commands in a real pty. workspace: scratch starts in an empty dir, from:<beat> carries on from an earlier session, skip drops a step that only the article needs.

beats.caption: The page itself, in both themes
beats.narration: A preview beat iframes a live page and, with themeAt, switches its theme partway through. path is relative to the served base: a Storybook story, or a route of the demo app.

beats.caption: What the series does next
beats.narration: The payoff, then where the next part goes.
